title: Talking about past experiences / Gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuu
bridge: Afaan Oromo, gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuuf, kan ‘kana malee’ (ani beeka) jechuun ‘kana hin beekne’ (ani hin beeka) jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Afaan Ingiliffa, gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuuf, ‘present perfect’ (have visited) jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Tokko tokko, afaan Oromo, gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuuf, ‘kana malee’ jechuun ‘kana hin beekne’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Haa ta’u malee, afaan Ingiliffa, ‘present perfect’ jechuun ‘have + participio’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffa, gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuuf, ‘present perfect’ jechuun ‘have/has + participio’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Kunimmoo: 1) gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuu (I have visited Paris), 2) gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuu kanarraa (She has lost her keys), 3) ‘ever’, ‘never’, ‘already’, ‘yet’, ‘just’, ‘before’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Seenaa hojjetu ‘have not’ (haven't) jechuu ‘has not’ (hasn't) jechuu akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Galataa hojjetu ‘Have you ever...?’ jechuu akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuuf, ‘Have you ever + participio?’ jechuu ‘Yes, I have’ jechuu ‘No, I never have’ jechuu akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. ‘Present perfect’ jechuun ‘yesterday’, ‘last week’, ‘in 2010’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Kanarratti, ‘past simple’ (visited, went) jechuu akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. A2, ‘go-gone’, ‘eat-eaten’, ‘see-seen’, ‘have-had’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

concept_examples.text: I have visited Mexico.
She has never eaten sushi.
Have you ever seen that movie?
We have already finished our homework.

common_error.explanation: Erraa kana hin qabne afaan Oromo, ‘Ani Pariisiin kee beeka’ jechuun ‘yesterday’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Haa ta’u malee, afaan Ingiliffa, ‘present perfect’ jechuun ‘yesterday’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. Gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuuf, ‘past simple’ (visited) jechuu akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba. ‘Present perfect’ jechuun gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuu kanarraa, ‘past simple’ jechuu akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

examples.original: Have you ever been to London?
examples.note: ‘Ever’ jechuun gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuu kanarraa, galataa hojjetutti akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

examples.original: I have never tried Thai food.
examples.note: ‘Never’ jechuun ‘have’ fi participio raawwataniitti akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

examples.note: ‘Flown’ jechuu ‘fly’ jechuu irraa adda ta’e.
‘Already’ jechuun seenaa hojjetutti akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

examples.original: Have you bought the tickets yet?
examples.note: ‘Yet’ jechuun galataa hojjetutti fi seenaa hojjetutti akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

examples.original: We haven't finished our project yet.
examples.note: ‘Yet’ jechuun seenaa hojjetutti akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.
‘Present perfect’ jechuun gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuu kanarraa akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɛnt tə pəˈruː ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd nɪnˈtiːn/
examples.note: ‘Past simple’ jechuun gaaffii sirrii olaanuu harsisiisuu kanarraa akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

‘Past simple’ jechuun ‘see’ jechuun ‘saw’ jechuun akka ta’ee ittiin hojjetamu qaba.

title: Making Plans and Arrangements / Miilaa fi wal-qixxeesa godhamu
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, miilaa fi wal-qixxeesa godhamu akkas jedhanii haa ilaallu; ‘hanga’ (ani jiru) yookin ‘qoraphie’ (ani qoraphie) jechuudha. Afaan Ingilizii, miilaa fi wal-qixxeesa godhamu ‘present continuous’ (I'm meeting) hin ta’e ‘be going to’ (I'm going to visit) jechuudha. Haa ta’u: Afaan Ingilizii, ‘present simple’ hin qabaminii akkas jedha; ‘I call you tomorrow’ hin jedhu; ‘I'll call you tomorrow’ jechuudha. ‘Will’ yoo akkas jedhu, miilaa dubbii hin ta’e, wal-qixxeesa dubbii ta’e jechuudha.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii A2 irra deebii akkas jedhi:

1. **Present continuous** (am/is/are + -ing): miilaa fi wal-qixxeesa godhamee, guyyaa fi magaalaa kan ta’e. Misola: 'I'm seeing the doctor at 3.' (Wal-qixxeesa godhamee).

2. **Be going to** (am/is/are going to + infinitive): miilaa yookin wal-qixxeesa dubbii, guyyaa fi magaalaa hin ta’e. Misola: 'We're going to visit our grandparents.' (Miilaa dubbii).

3. **Will** (will + base verb): wal-qixxeesa sirrii, godhaa yookin gosa. Misola: 'I'll help you with that.' (Wal-qixxeesa sirrii).

4. **Would like to** (would like to + infinitive): godhaa yookin miilaa haala dhaabachuu. Misola: 'Would you like to come to my party?'

Afaan Ingilizii, ‘present simple’ miilaa hin qabaminii akkas jedha; ‘be going to’ yookin ‘present continuous’ miilaa godhamu.

title: Giving advice and recommendations / Gaaffii fi baraawwan godhamu
bridge: Afaan Oromo, gaaffii godhamu akkas jedhanii keessatti argama, kan qabdi dhaabbata (te recomiendo que vayas, deberías ir) kan ta’ee jechuudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessumaa, dhaabbataa kan qabdi ‘recommend’ ama ‘suggest’ hin qabdi’u; nama qabicha hojii ama midhaasiif infinitive hojii qabnu: ‘I recommend you go’, ‘I suggest you try’. Hojii ‘should’ (deberías) kan qabnuufis dhaga’u; wanti ‘must’ kan ta’ee jechuu miti. Akkasumas, ‘I recommend that you go’ dhugumaa ta’e, ‘I recommend you to go’ jedhuu akkasii danda’uun hin taane; wantoota ‘recommend’ akkasumas ‘suggest’ kan ta’u akkasii ‘to’ hin qabdi’in.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii keessatti gaaffii fi baraawwan godhamu akkasii jedhuu dandeessaa:
1. **Should / Shouldn't + hojii qabicha**: gaaffii dhaabachuu akkasumas baraawwan godhamu. Fakkeenya: 'You should eat more vegetables.' 'You shouldn't stay up late.' (seena qajeela). Kanatti hin qabdi’in (he should, no he shoulds).
2. **You could + hojii qabicha**: baraawwan godhamu akkasumas deebii akkasii godhamu. Fakkeenya: 'You could try yoga.'
3. **I recommend / I suggest + that + macaafii + hojii qabicha** (‘to’ hin qabdi’in fi dhaabbataa hin qabdi’in). Fakkeenya: 'I recommend that you see a doctor.' Akkasumas gerund hojii qabnu dandeessaa: 'I recommend seeing a doctor.' ama 'I suggest trying this.'
4. **How about + gerund (-ing)?**: baraawwan godhamu akkasii jechuu dandeessaa. Fakkeenya: 'How about going for a walk?'
5. **Why don't you + hojii qabicha?**: baraawwan godhamu akkasii jechuu dandeessaa. Fakkeenya: 'Why don't you take a break?'
Qoro: ‘must’ gaaffii godhamu akkasii hin qabnu; ‘must’ baraawwan godhamu akkasii ta’e jechuu miti. Baraawwan godhamu akkasii jechuuf, ‘could’ ama ‘might’ qabnuufis dhaga’u. Akkasumas, ‘recommend’ akkasumas ‘suggest’ kan ta’u akkasii ‘to’ hin qabdi’in: ‘I recommend you to go’ jedhuu akkasii danda’uun hin taane.

concept_examples.text: You should drink more water.
I recommend that you talk to the teacher.
concept_examples.translation: Seenaa baraa ta’uun seenaa baafacha isa godhi.

Akkasii jedhuu dandeessaa: ‘recommend + that + macaafii + hojii qabicha’ ama ‘recommend + gerund’. title: Expressing opinions / Fidhiiwwan godhuu
bridge: Afaan Oromootti 'creo que' fi 'pienso que' malee walii tokko tokkoof jechuu dandeenye, Afaan Ingilizii keessatti kunimmaa’uudha. 'I think' haala dhaabachuu fi haalaa isaaniiwwan godhuu wajjin tokko dhaabbata, 'I believe' gosa irra deebi’anii fi hojjii irra deebi’anii godhuu wajjin tokko dhaabbata. Akkasumas, 'that' Afaan Ingilizii keessatti haala malees jiraachuu qabna; haa ta’ee akkasii haa godhu. Afaan Oromoos immoo, 'en' fi 'de' jiraataniiwwan godhuu danda’u.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii A2 keessatti fidhiiwwan godhuu haa ta’ee akkasii haa godhu:
- 'I think (that) + gaafadhu' – fidhiiwwan fi haalaa isaaniiwwan godhuu wajjin.
- 'I believe (that) + gaafadhu' – haala deebi’anii fi hojjii deebi’anii godhuu wajjin.
- 'In my opinion, + gaafadhu' – haala dhaabachuu fi haalaa isaaniiwwan godhuu wajjin, gara qolee’iiwwan dhaabachuu wajjin tokko dhaabbata.
Haala malee tokko tokkoof jechuu dandeenye: 'I guess' (haalaa isaaniiwwan godhuu) fi 'I suppose' (haalaa isaaniiwwan godhuu), lamaan tokko tokko dhaabbata.
Malees jiraachuu qabna; 'that' haala malees jiraachuu qabna. Gaafadhuu malees jiraachuu qabna: 'I think it is good' jedhu haa ta’ee akkasii haa godhu.

'Think' fi 'believe' Afaan Ingilizii keessatti 'in' fi 'on' haa ta’ee akkasii haa godhu. 'That' haala malees jiraachuu qabna; 'I think it is good' jedhu haa ta’ee akkasii haa godhu.

title: Agreeing and Disagreeing / Bilisummaa fi bilisummaan hin jiru
bridge: Afaan Oromo, bilisummaa hojjetti 'waa bilisummaa' jedhanii fi bilisummaan hin jiru 'waa hin bilisummaan' jedhanii akkaataa, garuu Afaan Ingilizii 'I agree' fi 'I disagree' jedhanii barbaachisaa fi dhiiraa ta'an malee. 'So do I' fi 'Neither do I' jedhanii Afaan Oromoos hin qabdiin, kanarratti dhaga'uudha. Fakkeenya, 'agree' amala qabaa malee, 'I am agree' hin jedhi; 'I agree' jedhi.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii bilisummaa hojjetti 'I agree' (waa bilisummaa) ama 'I think so' (waa hin bilisummaan) jedhi. Bilisummaan hin jiru 'I disagree' (waa hin bilisummaan) ama 'I don't think so' (waa hin bilisummaan) jedhi. Bilisummaa hojjetti 'So do I' (nan tola) ama 'Me too' (nan tola) jedhi. Bilisummaan hin jiru 'Neither do I' (nan tola hin jiru) ama 'Me neither' (nan tola hin jiru) jedhi. 'Exactly' (haa ta'a) ama 'That's right' (haa ta'a) jedhi bilisummaa hojjetti. 'I'm not sure' (waa hin bilisummaan) jedhi bilisummaan hin jiru. 'Agree' amala qabaa: I agree, you agree, he/she agrees. Bilisummaa hojjetti 'Do you agree?' jedhi.

concept_examples.text: I agree with you.
I disagree with that idea.
So do I.
Neither do I.

common_error.explanation: Qorophii kana malee, Afaan Oromo 'waa bilisummaa' jedhu 'waa' fi 'bilisummaa' amala qabaa ta'u, bara baraa 'I am agree' jedhanii. Afaan Ingilizii, 'agree' amala qabaa, 'to be' amala qabuu hin jiru. Haa ta'u 'agree' amala qabaa, 'I agree' ama 'I don't agree' jedhi.

levels.label: Basic Agreement and Disagreement
levels.translation: Bilisummaa fi bilisummaan hin jiru dheeraa

examples.note: Bilisummaa hojjetti dheeraa. Isa bira fi isa hin bira kanarratti argamu.
Bilisummaan hin jiru dheeraa. Isa bira hin qabnu hafan irra deebi'u.
Himaa ta'e hojjetti dheeraa.
Bilisummaan hin jiru dheeraa.

levels.label: Agreeing with Positive and Negative Statements

examples.note: Himaa ta'e hojjetti bilisummaa hojjetti. Fakkeenya: I like coffee. So do I.
Bilisummaa hojjetti dheeraa isa bira.
Himaa ta'e hin jiru bilisummaa hojjetti. Fakkeenya: I don't like tea. Neither do I.
'Neither do I' isa bira dheeraa.

levels.label: Polite Disagreement and Expressing Doubt
levels.translation: Bilisummaan hin jiru hafan irra deebi'u fi haala murtii

examples.note: Bilisummaan hin jiru hafan irra deebi'u dheeraa.
Bilisummaan hin jiru dheeraa isa bira.

examples.translation: Murtoo kee ta'e, hima kan hin jedhi...
examples.note: Murtoo keessan ta'e bilisummaa hojjetti dheeraa.

examples.translation: Himaa kan ta'e, hima hin jiru.
examples.note: Bilisummaan hin jiru hafan irra deebi'u dheeraa.

title: Describing Daily Routines / Rutinuuwwan guyyaa dhaabbataa qajeelfama
bridge: Afaan Oromo, ‘kana hin mi’e’ jechuu’ akkas jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa akkas jechuudha. Afaan Ingiliffa, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’uuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu: ‘I get up’ jedhaa hojiichaa qaba. Akkasumas, Afaan Oromo, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu (‘desayuno’), Afaan Ingiliffa, ‘I’ (‘I have breakfast’) jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu. Akkasumas, Afaan Ingiliffa, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu, ‘he gets up’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, ‘always’, ‘usually’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu (‘siempre me levanto’ vs. ‘I always get up’).
rule: Afaan Ingiliffa, rutinuuwwan guyyaa dhaabbataa qajeelfama, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu (present simple). Adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa: Barbaachisaa + adabbi (he/she/it -s) + barbaachisaa. Adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa keessatti dhaabbataa ta’u, ‘to be’ adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa keessatti dhaabbataa ta’u. ‘In the morning’, ‘at night’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa keessatti dhaabbataa ta’u. Afaan Ingiliffa, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu.

concept_examples.text: I wake up at six every morning.
concept_examples.translation: Mana hinkiloonni guyyaa dhaabbataa ishee mi’e.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ weɪk ʌp æt sɪks ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She usually takes a shower in the evening.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈjuʒuəli teɪks ə ˈʃaʊər ɪn ðə ˈivnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: We have breakfast together at home.
concept_examples.translation: Namoonni manaa mana dhaabbataa ishee mi’e.

concept_examples.text: They always go to bed at eleven.
concept_examples.translation: Manaa hinkiloonni guyyaa dhaabbataa ishee mi’e.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɔlweɪz goʊ tu bɛd æt ɪˈlɛvən/

common_error.explanation: Hordofsuu dhaabachuu qabnaa kan hin qabne barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu. Afaan Oromo, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu (‘se despierta’), Afaan Ingiliffa, -s akkas jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu. Akkasumas, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu (‘Wakes up’), Afaan Ingiliffa, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu. Inni qabnu: he/she/it, -s adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa keessatti dhaabbataa ta’u.

examples.translation: Mana hinkiloonni guyyaa dhaabbataa ishee mi’e.
examples.note: ‘Get up’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, ‘wake up’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu.
Afaan Ingiliffa, ‘his’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, ‘se’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu.
‘Have’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, ‘drink’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu.

examples.original: They go to work by car.
examples.translation: Namoonni manaa mana dhaabbataa ishee mi’e.
examples.note: ‘By’ + haala dhaabbataa (by car, by bus) jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu.

examples.translation: Mana Afaan Ingiliffa baraa keessatti baraa.
examples.note: ‘After’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, Afaan Oromo, barbaachisaa haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu.

examples.translation: Isheen telee barsiisuu dhaabbataa ishee mi’e.
examples.note: He/she/it, ‘watch’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, ‘watches’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu.

examples.original: I always eat lunch at noon.
examples.translation: Mana hinkiloonni guyyaa dhaabbataa ishee mi’e.
examples.note: ‘Always’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, ‘eat’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu.

examples.original: He usually reads the news in the morning.
examples.phonetic: /hi ˈjuʒuəli ridz ðə nuz ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
examples.note: ‘Usually’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, barbaachisaa fi adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa keessatti dhaabbataa ta’u.

examples.translation: Manaa hinkiloonni guyyaa dhaabbataa ishee mi’e.
examples.note: ‘Never’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa amanu, ‘don’t’ jechuuf adabbi haala dhaabbaa ta’ee barbaachisaa hin amanu.

title: Talking about health and symptoms / Afaan Ingilizii keessatti amantii fi cabsee galmeeffadha
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessatti amantii fi cabsee galmeeffadha barbaachisaa ‘kana’ jechuun isaanii argachuu danda'a. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti haala malee, ‘have’ (kana) fi ‘feel’ (adabii) barbaachisaa isaanii argachuu danda'a. Fakkeenya, ‘I have a headache’ (kana baqaa ta’ee) fi ‘I feel sick’ (adabii waan tokko). Dhugumsa akkasii kan danda’amne ‘I have cold’ jedhuu akkasumas ‘I have a cold’ jedhaa ta’uudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘cold’ (baqaa) fi ‘headache’ (baqaa ta’ee) barbaachisaa isaanii argachuu danda'a. ‘Ache’ akkasumas seenaa tokko tokkoo keessatti barbaaddaa: ‘headache’ (baqaa ta’ee), ‘toothache’ (baqaa dhibbaa), garuu ‘pain’ (baqaa) seenaa amantii akkamiiwwan barbaaddaa. Kanarratti wal fakkaatu akkamiiwwan barbaachuu dhowwachiisuu danda'a.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii keessatti amantii fi cabsee galmeeffadha A2 sirrii keessatti akkasii godha:

1. **Have + barbaachis:** ‘Have’ (kana) barbaachis haala malees nama ‘a’ barbaachis keessatti argachuu danda'a: ‘I have a cold’ (kana baqaa), ‘I have a headache’ (kana baqaa ta’ee), ‘I have a toothache’ (kana baqaa dhibbaa).

2. **Feel + adabii:** Adabii galmeeffadha ‘feel’ fi adabii barbaachisaa danda'a: ‘I feel tired’ (adabii waan tokko), ‘I feel sick’ (adabii waan tokko), ‘I feel dizzy’ (adabii waan tokko).

3. **Baqaa amantii:** Baqaa amantii akkamiiwwan ‘I have pain in my back’ (kana baqaa sirrii) fi ‘my back hurts’ (baqaa sirrii).

4. **Hurt jechuu:** ‘Hurt’ jechuu baqaa galmeeffadha barbaaddaa: ‘My head hurts’ (baqaa ta’ee), ‘My stomach hurts’ (baqaa qarsa).

5. **Amantii galmeeffadha:** ‘What's wrong?’ (amaanii waan ta’ee?), ‘Are you okay?’ (amaanii waan ta’ee?), ‘How do you feel?’ (amaanii waan ta’ee?).

6. **Haala malees:** ‘Should’ fi ‘shouldn’t’ barbaachisaa danda'a: ‘You should see a doctor’ (haala malees), ‘You shouldn’t eat that’ (haala malees).

**Dhugumsa fi haala malees:**
- ‘Cold’ (baqaa) barbaachis haala malees ‘a cold’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
- ‘Flu’ (baqaa) haala malees ‘the flu’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
- ‘Fever’ (baqaa) barbaachis haala malees ‘a fever’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
- ‘Sore throat’ (baqaa qarsa) barbaachis haala malees ‘a sore throat’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
- Baqaa amantii akkamiiwwan ‘I have a cough’ (fi ‘to cough’), ‘I have a runny nose’ (fi ‘I have a runny nose’).

**Haala malees:** Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘make’ jechuu baqaa amantii akkamiiwwan barbaaddaa (‘me duele’ = ‘it hurts’ fi ‘I have pain’).

concept_examples.text: I have a headache.
I feel sick.
My stomach hurts.
You should see a doctor.

common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘kana baqaa’ jechuun ‘I have cold’ jedhuu akkasumas ‘I have a cold’ jedhaa ta’uudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘cold’ (baqaa) barbaachis haala malees ‘a cold’ jedhaa ta’uudha. ‘Have got’ jechuu haala malees akkasumas ta’uudha. ‘Kana baqaa’ (baqaa) jechuu ‘I am cold’ fi ‘I feel cold’ jedhaa ta’uudha, ‘I have cold’ jedhaa ta’uudha.

examples.note: ‘A cough’ barbaachis haala malees ‘a’ jedhaa ta’uudha. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘kana baqaa’ jechuun ‘a’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
‘A fever’ barbaachis haala malees ‘a’ jedhaa ta’uudha. Afaan Oromo keessatti ‘kana baqaa’ jechuun ‘a’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
‘Sore throat’ jechuu haala malees ‘pain in the throat’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
‘Feel’ fi adabii barbaachisaa danda'a. ‘I am having dizzy’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
‘Tired’ jechuu adabii haala malees ‘I feel tired’ fi ‘I am tired’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
‘How are you?’ fi ‘How do you feel?’ jechuu haala malees ‘I feel good’ jedhaa ta’uudha.

levels.label: Giving and asking about health advice

examples.note: Amaanii waan ta’ee galmeeffadha haala malees ‘What’s wrong?’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
‘Should’ fi ‘shouldn’t’ barbaachisaa danda'a. ‘Should to rest’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
‘Take’ jechuu haala malees ‘drink’ fi ‘eat’ jedhaa ta’uudha.
‘Shouldn’t’ jechuu ‘should’ jechuu haala malees ‘shouldn’t’ jedhaa ta’uudha.

title: Making requests and offers / Gaaffii fi cabbii godhaman
bridge: Afaan Oromootti gaaffii kennu malee 'Maqaa keessan dandeessu?' jedhanii kana maleesu 'Hunda qabna?' jedhaa ta'u, Afaan Ingilizii gara fuulaa 'Can' fi 'Could' jechuudhaan hordofsiisu. Cabbii godhaman maleesu, Afaan Oromootti 'Maqaa keessan barbaachisu?' jedhanii kana maleesu 'Hunda barbaachaa?' jedhaa ta'u, Afaan Ingilizii gara fuulaa 'Can I...?' fi 'Do you want me to...?' jechuudhaan hordofsiisu. Dhaga'u: Afaan Ingilizii 'Could you...?' jechuu 'Can you...?' jechuu miti. Gaaffii kennu maleesu deebii kennu godhachuu qabna; sababaa tokkoo ta'ee hordofsiisu.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii gaaffii kennu A2 sirrii, gara fuulaa:
- 'Can you + verb...?' (qophi'aa, amantii)
- 'Could you + verb...?' (astaa fi hordofsiisu)
- 'Would you mind + gerund?' (astaa, garuu barbaachisaa).
Cabbii godhaman maleesu:
- 'Can I + verb...?' (Maqaa keessan dandeessu?)
- 'Do you want me to + verb...?' (Maqaa keessan barbaachisu?)
- 'Would you like me to + verb...?' (astaa).
Afaan Ingilizii 'Can' fi 'Could' gara fuulaa, miila ta'u barbaachisu. Cabbii godhaman maleesu, 'me to' gara fuulaa 'want' fi 'like' jechuudhaan hordofsiisu. 'Do you want that...' jedhanii Afaan Oromootti ta'u barbaachisu.

concept_examples.text: Can you help me with this?
concept_examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu in ni barbaachisu?

concept_examples.text: Could you open the window, please?
concept_examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu tii eeggannu sochootu barbaachisu?

concept_examples.text: Can I give you a hand?
concept_examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu in ni cabbuu?

concept_examples.text: Do you want me to get you a coffee?
concept_examples.translation: Maqaa keessan barbaachisu in ni qaxxuun qabnu?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː wɒnt miː tə ɡet juː ə ˈkɒfi/

common_error.wrong: Do you want that I help you?
common_error.correct: Do you want me to help you?
common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromootti 'Maqaa keessan in ni barbaachisu?' jedhanii, barumsa 'that I' jedhanii ta'u barbaachisu. Afaan Ingilizii, sirna 'want + person + to + verb' jechuudhaan hordofsiisu, 'that + subject + verb' jechuu miti. Sirna kana 'Can I help you?' jedhanii ta'u barbaachisu, qophi'aa fi amantii.

examples.original: Can you pass me the salt?
examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu in ni sochoa ta'u?
examples.note: Amantii sirrii tokko tokkootti. 'Pass me' jechuu 'ta'u' jechuudhaan ta'u.

examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu tii bakkaa sochootu?
examples.note: 'Can' jechuu gaaffii kennu qophi'aa irraa ta'u.

examples.original: Can you speak more slowly, please?
examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu in ni wal qophaa ta'u, fadii keessu?
examples.note: 'Please' jechuu gara fuulaa hordofsiisu.

examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu in ni guyyaa wajjin walqixxu?
examples.note: 'Could' jechuu astaa fi hordofsiisu irraa ta'u.

examples.original: Could you bring us the menu, please?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː brɪŋ ʌs ðə ˈmenjuː pliːz/
examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu in ni manni bakkaa ta'u, fadii keessu?
examples.note: Restoran irra 'could' jechuu 'can' jechuu miti.

examples.original: Could you help me carry these bags?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː help miː ˈkæri ðiːz bæɡz/
examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu in ni baggaasaa kan cabbuu godhu?
examples.note: Cabbii godhaman guddaa irra 'could' jechuu hordofsiisu.

examples.original: Can I get you something to drink?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡet juː ˈsʌmθɪŋ tə drɪŋk/
examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dandeessu in ni qaxxuun qabnu?
examples.note: Cabbii godhaman amantii, 'Maqaa keessan qaxxuun qabnu?' jedhanii ta'u.

examples.original: Do you want me to help you with that?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː wɒnt miː tə help juː wɪð ðæt/
examples.translation: Maqaa keessan barbaachisu in ni cabbuu?
examples.note: Sirna 'want + me + to' jechuudhaan cabbii godhaman sirrii.

examples.original: Would you like me to open the window?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː laɪk miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.translation: Maqaa keessan dhaabbata in tii eeggannu sochootu?
examples.note: 'Do you want me to' jechuu miti. Astaa fi hordofsiisu irraa ta'u.

title: Expressing Ability and Possibility / Harkaafi qabda dhufan bira
bridge: Harkaafi qabda dhufan bira barbaachisaa kan Oromoo keessatti 'dhaqaa' harkaafi 'qabda' qabdaa hin jiru. Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, lafa qoraniif 'can' (hojii) hanga 'could' (guyyaa) kanarraa barbaachisaa lamaan qaban. Hegaaddis, 'could' guyyaa walitti dhiisiifama qabda (fakkaachaa, 'Could you swim?') hanga 'be able to' hojjechaatti waanuma 'can' hin qabne barbaachisaa lamaan qaban. Harkaafi qabda dhufan bira, 'can' hanga 'could' barbaachisaa umrii qaban, 'may' hanga 'might' barbaachisaa hin kennamne qaban, kana keessummaa Afaan Oromoo keessatti hin jiru.
rule: Harka hojii keessatti qabachuu wajjin, 'can' + qoraniif (fakkaachaa, 'I can swim'). Guyyaa keessatti, harka umrii qabachuu wajjin, 'could' + qoraniif (fakkaachaa, 'I could swim when I was young'). Guyyaa walitti dhiisiifama qabda (dhaabbata), 'was/were able to' (hordof 'could') qaba. Qabda dhufan bira, 'can' barbaachisaa umrii qaban (fakkaachaa, 'It can rain'), 'could' barbaachisaa guyyaa ama qorophii qaban (fakkaachaa, 'It could rain later'), 'may' hanga 'might' barbaachisaa hin kennamne qaban (fakkaachaa, 'She may come'). 'Can' seerawwan 'cannot' ama 'can't', 'could' seerawwan 'couldn't'. 'To' 'can' ama 'could' hin deebi’u.

concept_examples.text: I can speak English and Spanish.
Could you help me, please?
She might be at home now.
We were able to find the hotel after asking.
concept_examples.translation: Guyyaa kennaniif, hojii keessan argatanii dandeessan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː wɜːr ˈeɪbəl tə faɪnd ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈæftər ˈæskɪŋ/

common_error.wrong: I can to play the guitar.
common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromoo keessatti 'dhaqaa...a' jechuudhaan qabnu, 'to' 'can' hin deebinu. Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, 'can' qoraniif hojii deebisu, 'to' hin deebinu. Fakkaachaa: can + qoraniif, hinis can + to + qoraniif.

examples.note: 'Can' harka hojii keessatti qabachuu wajjin. Akkasumas, Afaan Oromoo keessatti 'dhaqaa' ama 'qabda' jechuudhaan qabnu, Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti 'can' bakka hin jiru.
Gaffii keessatti, 'can' qabeessa deebisu.
Seerawwan 'can't' (seerawwan 'cannot').

levels.label: Ability and Possibility in the Past

examples.original: When I was a child, I could run fast.
examples.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ wəz ə tʃaɪld, aɪ kʊd rʌn fæst/
examples.note: 'Could' harka umrii guyyaa keessatti qabachuu wajjin.

examples.original: I was able to finish the exam yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wəz ˈeɪbəl tə ˈfɪnɪʃ ði ɪɡˈzæm ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Guyyaa kennaniif, hojii keessan argatanii dandeessan.
examples.note: Dhaabbata guyyaa walitti dhiisiifama qabda, 'was/were able to' bakka 'could' hin jiru.
Guyyaa keessatti, 'could' qabda dhufan bira barbaachisu.
'May' ajajni ama ajajni umrii qabachuu wajjin.
'Might' qabda hin kennamne qabachuu wajjin, haasa’aa hojii keessatti.
Afaan Ingiliffii irra deebi’anii keessatti, 'can' ajajni qabachuu wajjin.

title: Talking about weather / Harreratti himi
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, himi ‘it’ jedhanii fayyadama qabna. ‘It is hot’, ‘It is raining’ jedhu. Kana malees, himi Afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘himi’ jedhamtu hinqabne; ‘jallati’ ‘himi’ jedhaa ta’e malee, ‘jallata’ himi tokko qaban hinjiru. ‘Weather’ Afaan Ingilizii keessatti guyyaa hinqabne, ‘a weather’ ‘weathers’ jedhu hinbaakne.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii A2 keessatti himi qajeelfama:
1. ‘It is’ + ajjeesa: It is sunny, It is cloudy, It is windy, It is cold, It is warm.
2. ‘It is’ + feesi gochuu: It is raining, It is snowing, It is hailing.
3. ‘There is’ + macaaf: There is a storm, There is fog, There is a rainbow.
4. ‘There are’ + macaaf ol’aa: There are clouds, There are showers.

Gaffii fi qoratti: ‘It is hot’ fi ‘It is cold’ guyyaa qabanis; ‘It's warm’ fi ‘It's cool’ kan qabda. Gaaffii, ‘What's the weather like?’ ‘How's the weather?’ jedhaa ta’u malee, ‘How is the weather?’ jedha hinbaakne. ‘Weather’ guyyaa hinqabne; ‘a weather’ jedha hinbaakne.

concept_examples.text: It is sunny today.
It is raining outside.
It is very cold in winter.
There are some clouds in the sky.
concept_examples.translation: Samii keessummaa qoratti jiraatanii jiraachuu dha.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðər ər sʌm klaʊdz ɪn ðə skaɪ/

common_error.explanation: Afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘himi jallata’ ‘jallati’ jedhamtu ta’e, barreeffame tokko tokko ‘himi jallata’ jechuudha. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti himi himaataa qajeelfama ‘it’ fayyadama qabna; ‘the weather’ jedhu hinbaakne. ‘The weather is hot’ jechuu miti; ‘It is hot’ jechuu dhugaa. ‘Hot’ jallataa qajeelfama, himaataa qajeelfachuu hinqabne.

examples.note: ‘Sunny’ guyyaa jalaa jiraachuu qajeelfama. Afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘guyyaa jalaa jiraachuu dha’ jedhamtu.
‘Cloudy’ samii qoratti jiraachuu qajeelfama. Afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘samii qoratti jiraachuu dha’ jedhamtu.
‘Windy’ guyyaa ba’aa jiraachuu qajeelfama. ‘Wind’ macaaf qajeelfama hinqabne.
Jallata qopheessu qajeelfama. ‘Cold’ jallataa fi mirga qajeelfachuu qabda.
Feesi gochuu ‘be + -ing’ fayyadama qabna. Afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘deebi’i jiraachuu dha’ jedhamtu.
Bishaan barreeffame bishaan qopheessaa keessaa jiraachuu qabda. ‘Snow’ macaaf qajeelfama, ‘snowing’ feesi gochuu qajeelfama.
‘Hail’ qoratti macaaf qajeelfama. Barreeffamee qoratti jiraachuu hinjiru.
Samiin guuteeffama fi jalaa biroo jiraachuu qajeelfama.
Gaaffii irra deebisuu ‘like’ fayyadama qabna.

examples.original: It will be rainy on Friday.
examples.note: Irra deebisuu ‘will’ fayyadama qabna. ‘Rainy’ ajjeesa, ‘raining’ feesi gochuu qajeelfama.

examples.original: It is going to snow tonight.
examples.note: ‘Going to’ irra deebisuu qajeelfama, tokkorratti himi irra deebisuuf qoratti jiraatanii dha.

examples.original: There will be a storm tomorrow.
examples.note: ‘There will be’ irra deebisuu qajeelfama, macaaf irra deebisuuf qabda.
